mapper.sql: id, event_id, trace_id, stat_date, campaign_id, unit_id, creative_id, advertiser_id, event_type, amount_cents, status, charge_mode, reject_reason, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into ad_charge_record (event_id, trace_id, stat_date, campaign_id, unit_id, creative_id, advertiser_id, event_type, amount_cents, status, charge_mode, reject_reason) values (#{eventId}, #{traceId}, #{statDate}, #{campaignId}, #{unitId}, #{creativeId}, #{advertiserId}, #{eventType}, #{amountCents}, #{status}, #{chargeMode}, #{rejectReason})
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(amount_cents), 0) from ad_charge_record where campaign_id = #{campaignId} and status = 2
